scoringCorrection: The first runner required the initial request after restart to be smaller than half of the largest pre-compaction request. That restart occurred after two new large diagnostic batches. The same replacement rule is applied to both drivers and both windows: SDK auto boundary for a pre-context of at least 80000 tokens, post-tokens below 50% of the SDK pre-tokens, and a still-reduced first request after restart. Exact deliverable and state checks are unchanged.
scope: Native SDK auto-compaction within the same persisted SDK session, followed by a clean runtime restart, using synthetic data and two thresholds. Does not test app checkpoint reconstruction after forced stop/crash, default window, or remote side effects.
